"Tum goals pe nahi—tum system pe rise/ fall karte."
Chahe tum socho tum kar sakte ho, ya tum nahi kar sakte—tum sahi ho.

Success focus aur continuous effort maangti hai.
"Apni speed se peace banao."
Chalte raho; mushkil badhe toh growth bhi badhe.
Discipline goals aur accomplishment ke beech ki bridge hai.
Dhyan se dekho.
Success tab aata jab yakeen ho ki tum kar sakte.

"Right opportunity ka wait mat karo."
"Seekho. Phir lead karo."
